Amrit Corporate Centre, A-95 Sector 65 Noida U.p.-201309 Through Mr Rishabh Aggarwal Vice President (Fin And Tax) Aged About 36 Years S/o Sh. Umesh Chander Aggarwal R/o A-148 Vivek Vihar Delhi -110095 ----Petitioner Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Food Inspector Directorate Of Medical And Health Services C Scheme Ashok Nagar Jaipur Raj. -302007 2.
Chief Medical And Health Officer, Hanumangarh New Civil Lines Hanumangarh Raj.-335512
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Vineet Jain, Sr. Advocate, assisted by Mr. Rahul Choudhary Mr. Ameyavikrama Thanvi Ms. Gayatri Singh
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Sumer Singh Rajpurohit, PP JUSTICE DINESH MEHTA Order 11/11/2022 1.

Mr. Jain, learned Senior Counsel submits that the sample of Vanaspati Ghee was taken on 18.06.2010 and the complaint in question came to be filed on 27.04.2011 and the petitioner has only recently been served with the copy of the laboratory test report along with the process.

He argues that as the report has been received after 10 years, petitioner's right under Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 to get re- examination of the sample from the Central Food Laboratory has been practically taken away, as the life of the vegetable ghee is only 9 months.
(2 of 2) [CRLMP-7264/2022]
2. In support of his contention, learned counsel for the petitioner relies upon the judgment of this Court rendered in the case of Dinesh Arya Vs. State of Rajasthan in S.B. Criminal Misc. (Pet.)
No.4040/2019 and Rajendra Vs. State of Rajasthan in S.B. Criminal Misc.(Pet.) No.475/2014.

4. Learned Public Prosecutor accepts notices on behalf of respondent No.1.
5. Let notices made returnable within a period of six weeks be issued to respondent No.2.
